notes.title: Rigid Chess v2.04 Now Live
notes.content:
Rigid Chess major updates as follows:[list]
[*] Newly refactored chess engine runs at 140%, on average, of previous chess engine.
[*] Numerous UI updates and enhancements.
[*] Save / Load game refactored to remove security issue.
[*] Save / Load scenarios refactored to remove security issue.
[*] Expanded Help sections.
[*] Added ability to export game state string for analysis. mod, and reimport!
[/list]
